This '''unidentified [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Twi'lek once visited the [[Kessel prison|Imperial Correctional Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. There he met with [[Dewt Kluskine]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warden of the prison facility, who was secretly running a major [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] smuggling operation.<ref name="kessel" />
